protocol_metadata.about: Firelight is a liquid staking protocol on the Flare Network that accepts FXRP (XRP bridged via Flare's FAssets system) as deposits and issues stXRP, an ERC-20 liquid staking token, on a 1:1 basis. The stXRP token accrues value over time as staking rewards accumulate and can be used across Flare DeFi protocols including DEXs, lending markets, and yield platforms. In Phase 2, staked FXRP will back a DeFi cover marketplace where protocols purchase on-chain protection against smart contract exploits, oracle manipulation, governance attacks, and bad debt — with cover fees flowing back to stakers as rewards. Firelight was incubated by Sentora (formed from the merger of IntoTheBlock and Trident Digital) and is supported by the Flare Network.
